messages:
Sam (AE): FYI TenX procurement returned the MSA with redlines. They're insisting on BYOK + KMS and want Net45 unless we pre-sign. Can legal take a look?

Leah (TenX): Confirming. Procurement needs executed MSA+DPA before they issue PO. Invoice needs setup fee shown separately.

Priya (Sales Ops): Please paste the redlines or link. Billing entity: TenX Global Inc. Default payment terms requested: Net45.

Sam (AE): Link (internal): https://box.com/s/tenx-msaredlines-xyz. Highlights: sect2 change "no export" -> "no transfer", sect5 BYOK/HSM clause, Exhibit B SLA 99.95% with MTTR table, add 7yr retention for audit.

Jenna (Legal): Got it. BYOK is non-standard for Hosted. Do they require BYOK across Hosted or only Dedicated/Private?

Devon (SE): Redwood Hosted doesn't support customer-managed keys. Dedicated/Private can. BYOK requires onboarding HSM/KMS and ops work.

Leah (TenX): They want encryption-at-rest BYOK. Prefer Dedicated in us-west.

Marco (Finance): Net45 acceptable with PO if exec signoff. Net30 requires credit approval. Invoices to ar@redwood.com, reference PO#.

Priya (Sales Ops): Procurement requests 3 Redwood signers (AE, Legal, Finance). Do we want to pre-sign to speed the PO?

Jenna (Legal): I'll prepare counter-redline limiting BYOK to Dedicated/Private and include key management acceptance language. Proposed snippet to add (tracked):

"Customer-managed encryption keys (BYOK): Customer-provided keys via approved KMS/HSM are supported for Dedicated and Private deployments as set out in Exhibit A. Redwood will not store persistent customer keys; key usage will be logged; rotation/compromise procedures per Section 9."

Jenna (Legal): SLA compromise: keep 99.9% baseline, add Exhibit B option for 99.95% on Dedicated with higher commitment and defined credits.

Devon (SE): Confirmed we can offer 99.95% for Dedicated with pinned capacity. BYOK integration has a setup lead time and one-time engineering fee.

Sam (AE): Leah — would TenX accept Dedicated + setup fee + BYOK integration one-time fees?

Leah (TenX): Potentially yes if TCO fits. Need order form with line items: Dedicated monthly, setup one-time, BYOK one-time, monthly invoice cadence.

Marco (Finance): Draft pricing: Dedicated-1 $9,000/mo; Setup $15,000 one-time; BYOK integration $6,500 one-time. Net30 if credit approved, else Net45.

Priya (Sales Ops): I'll draft the order form with PO# placeholder and set up DocuSign. Proposed signer order: Legal -> Finance -> AE -> Customer.

Sam (AE): Jenna, can you produce the tracked PDF by EOD for envelope?

Jenna (Legal): Yes, I'll upload tracked changes + summary by 6pm PT.

Devon (SE): I'll add a short ops note about BYOK requirements (networking, supported HSM vendors, estimated lead time 2-3 weeks).

Priya (Sales Ops): DocuSign envelope created: env_7f2a1b (internal link).

docusign-bot: Envelope env_7f2a1b created 4 docs attached placeholder.

Priya (Sales Ops): Envelope routing set: Redwood Legal -> Redwood Finance -> AE -> Customer. This ensures countersign redline and finance review before customer signs.

Marco (Finance): Will sign once credit clears. I can accept Net30 contingency if legal & ops notes are attached.

Leah (TenX): Procurement will fast-track once we see BYOK in MSA and the order form shows separate setup invoice. They'll aim to send PO same day if you pre-sign.

Jenna (Legal): Uploaded redline.

docusign-bot: Envelope env_7f2a1b updated 4 Jenna uploaded TenX_MSA_redline_tracked.pdf

Priya (Sales Ops): Envelope now routing.

Sam (AE): I'll follow up after the customer signs and PO is received. Thanks everyone :rocket:
